en: I'm... so glad I met you, Saejima-san... You're my... hero... Thank you.

Graaah...
Graaah...
Urgh... Fluh... Can't eat anymore... *snore*
(You gotta be kiddin' me.)
Yowch!
Oh! Good morning, Saejima-san.
...It ain't fuckin' mornin'. Shit, I thought ya died, man!
Oh. I'm sorry! But, you were worried for me? Hehe, that is music to my ears.
Unbelievable. Enjoy it while ya can, Sodachi, 'cause I'm goin'. Glad you're not dead.
Once again, I'm eternally grateful to you, Saejima-san!
If it weren't for you, in all likelihood they would've taken the dojo. It shames me to admit, but it's true. I'm still too weak.
What are ya sayin'? You ain't weak. Ya stood up to those jerks.
I'm gone for just a short time, and look how tough ya get!
I can't believe what I'm hearing! The great Saejima thinks I'm tough. Me!
(Already regretting what I said...)
All right. I gotta go. You keep protectin' the dojo... This place is chock-full of memories.
You can count on me! Please do take care, Saejima-san. And visit us again some day!
What happened here?
They did...
I'm Kanahara, and that was a very rude way to greet someone who's here to help you... After all, I represent Angel Real Estate. Most folks would welcome the appearance of an angel.
Angels don't go around roughin' up a buncha kids. An' neither do real estate agents, asshole.
Haha, you got me there. But you know, we did try to be reasonable.
All we wanted was to buy this dump. Sadly, Sodachi-san did not accept our offer. So, a little persuasion was called for.
You want Sodachi Dojo?
Well, not the dojo itself, but rather its excellent location.
We've been watching this property for a long time. Now that you all have completed the build-out, we're ready to take it off your hands.
There's a lot of profit to be made here... once we turn it into a high class gym for Kamurocho yuppies.
No more grimy dojo that lets in just anybody. We'll make the property what it was always destined to be: a goldmine.
And it's not like we're just taking it. We made a fair and generous offer.
But since Sodachi-san turned it down...
You shitbags used force. High class, indeed.
Well. Dojo masters are known for being obstinate, and rather stupid. Your friend is no exception.
This place isn't about money. It's... so much more... to so many people.
My, I'm surprised you had it in you to stand up, after the beating you took. Too bad such courage is useless when it's inside a weak body like yours.
I suppose you need more persuading. Gentlemen?
Who are the goons?
Guys Kanahara hired. And they're not just tough⑬they're armed! The students didn't stand a chance...
Okay. I get the picture. I'll take 'em.
No, don't!
This is my dojo. I will protect it with my own two fists.
I promised you that I'd keep this dojo going.
I may be weak, I may be a nobody, but I won't break my promise.
Sodachi...
This place is special. It's where some incredible students trained, and it's where we gave so much of ourselves, Saejima-san.
I'm not turning it over to some thugs who just want to make money. I never will!
I will fight for Sodachi Dojo!
BO-ring... Haha! Put them out of their misery, boys. This'll be cheaper than buying them out anyway.
Got it. Hehehe.
Saejima-san? Please, don't! I have to do this by myself...
Sodachi, aren't ya forgettin' something?
You're not the only one with great memories of this place.
It's special to me, too. Means more to me than I can say.
A dojo doesn't just belong to its master. It belongs to everyone who loves it, right?
So we all should fight for it.
Yes, we should!
Come on! I'll show ya the kind of fighter this dojo can churn out!
Can't wait. Get them, boys! Kill them!
